title: LLM-Based Policy Compliance Verification of Loan Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.20155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Banks rely on extensive internal policy frameworks to ensure that corporate lending decisions comply with regulatory requirements and internal risk standards. Reviewing loan applications against these policies is a largely manual and knowledge-intensive process, which can lead to overlooked policy violations or exceptions. This report presents a prototype of an LLM-based policy checker that automatically verifies loan applications against internal lending policies.   The proposed approach follows a two-step architecture. First, compliance-relevant rules are automatically extracted from policy documents and converted into structured, machine-readable representations. Second, loan applications are evaluated against the extracted rules to identify policy exceptions, non-compliant findings, missing information, and cases requiring manual review. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的贷款申请政策合规性验证
translated_abstract: 银行依靠庞大的内部政策框架来确保企业信贷决策符合监管要求和内部风险标准。对照这些政策审查贷款申请是一个主要依赖人工且知识密集型的过程，可能导致政策违规或例外情况被忽视。本报告提出了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的政策检查器原型，能够根据内部信贷政策自动验证贷款申请。所提出的方法采用两步式架构：第一步，从政策文件中自动提取与合规相关的规则，并将其转换为结构化的、机器可读的表示形式；第二步，根据提取的规则对贷款申请进行评估，以识别政策例外情况、不合规发现、缺失信息以及需要人工审查的案例。评估结果表明，规则提取过程在多次运行中具有高度的稳定性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的两步式政策检查器原型，通过自动从政策文件中提取结构化合规规则，并据此对贷款申请进行合规性验证，实现了信贷审批合规审查流程的自动化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a prototype LLM-based policy checker with a two-step architecture that automatically extracts structured compliance rules from policy documents and evaluates loan applications against them, automating policy compliance verification in corporate lending.
